debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d the i-m-p-o-r-t-e-d s-t-o-c-k i-n-t-o n-e-w p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g and l-e-f-t a s-h-e-l-f t-a-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y s-c-a-n
2) they t-a-r-g-e-t-e-d the s-e-r-i-a-l i-s-s-u-e r-e-c-o-r-d s and l-e-f-t a l-o-g e-n-t-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-y-s-t-e-m a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e
3) they a-l-t-e-r-e-d the c-o-l-d c-h-a-i-n t-e-m-p-l-o-g s and l-e-f-t a p-a-p-e-r c-o-p-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-a-l-i-b-r-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-y
4) they m-o-v-e-d the g-o-o-d-s i-n-t-o p-h-a-r-m-a-c-y p-i-p-e-s and l-e-f-t a b-i-l-l o-f l-a-d-d-w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-o-u-t-i-n-g a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l
5) they s-e-n-t a c-o-p-y o-f t-h-e n-o-t-e s and l-e-f-t a f-i-l-e d a-t-a-b-a-s-e e-n-t-r-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g d-u-t-y
